unknownCompression: The XISF file uses an unknown compression: {codec}. zlib, LZ4 and Zstandard are supported.
notValid: The file is not a valid XISF.
noImages: The XISF file contains no images.
invalidSize: The XISF file declares invalid dimensions.
tooManyDimensions: The XISF file contains an image with more than two dimensions.
unsupportedPixelFormat: The XISF file uses an unsupported pixel format ({format}).
undeclaredPixelFormat: The XISF file uses an unsupported pixel format (not declared).
truncatedImage: The XISF file is truncated: the image data is missing.
missingEmbeddedData: The XISF file declares embedded data that is missing.
unsupportedLocation: The XISF file specifies the data in an unsupported way ({location}).
truncatedPixels: The XISF file is truncated: there are fewer pixels than declared.
